title: fix(lint): the approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty remedy names the admin bulk import's manager_id column
body:
Fixes #22683

Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

On a node whose approvers are all `{ type: 'manager' }`, `os lint` reports `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` (info). Its hint ended the SCIM clause with "and its admin bulk import does not write it either". That has been false since the import admitted a `manager_id` column (PR #18046), so the remedy sent an author with a whole file of reports away from a supported route. The guide (`automation/approvals.mdx`, corrected by PR #22681) already names that column and says `os lint` "carries the same remedy text", so the lint string was one clause behind it.

## What changed (3 files, +69 / -15)

- `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts`
  - `MANAGER_ONLY_ROUTES`: the false clause is gone. The bulk import (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/import-users`) is named as a route that works, right after the endpoint and its refusals and ahead of the clause that hands SCIM and directory sync to the deployment. It reads a `manager_id` column holding the manager's email (or phone where phone sign-in is enabled), links each row once every row in the file exists, through the same refusals, and reports a link it cannot make on that row's `manager` result without failing the user. The `idp_provisioned` clause keeps its wording and now says the import's column is refused too.
  - `MANAGER_ONLY_REMEDY`: names Set Manager (Setup → Users, row menu or record header) beside the endpoint it posts to. The card's done-when says "beside Set Manager and the endpoint"; the hint did not name Set Manager at all before, so this is the one addition beyond dropping the clause. The word "Console" is still used only inside the existing denial.
  - The file's own docblock graded the import "NOT here ... ruled but a separate change"; that grade is replaced with the measured one, so no comment in the file contradicts the string.
  - Unchanged: what the rule fires on, its level (`info`), `stackWiresManagerChain` as the one silencer, the fallback clause, the closing sentences.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.test.ts`: the pin on "admin bulk import does not write it either" is replaced. The 'GRADES the routes' test now asserts the import path, `reads a manager_id column`, `once every row in the file exists`, the per-row report, that the old clause is gone, and that the import is named before the clause that hands the remaining routes to the deployment. The 'names the REAL remedy' test asserts Set Manager.
- `.changeset/22683-approver-remedy-bulk-import.md`: `@objectstack/lint` patch, `Clause-②: no`.

## Premise check (measured on origin/main cb3bb9333f before writing a sentence)

The import does what the new sentence says, read in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts`: `MANAGER_COLUMN = 'manager_id'`; `resolveManagerKey` reads the cell as an email, or a phone number only when the phone plugin is wired; the cell is deleted from the row before the identity write; the second pass runs after `runImport` returns, resolves the key against this batch's rows and then against `sys_user`, and calls `applyUserManagerLink` (the endpoint's derivation); a failure goes to `noteManagerFailure` on the row, never a whole-import failure; `dryRun` skips the pass. Behaviour: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts` after building `@objectstack/plugin-auth^...`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 20 passed (20)`, including a link to a manager created by a later row and its control where the manager does not exist yet.

## Grep for the family (the card's done-when), on this branch at head d63e3f6ec1

```
$ git grep -n "bulk import does not write" -- packages/lint/src content/docs skills
(no output; exit 1)

$ git grep -n "bulk import does not write" cb3bb9333f -- packages/lint/src content/docs skills     # positive control, the base commit
cb3bb9333f:packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.test.ts:313:    expect(finding.hint).toContain('admin bulk import does not write it either');
cb3bb9333f:packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts:199:  `admin bulk import does not write it either — and where an identity carries ` +
```

A wider pass over `packages`, `content`, `skills` (CHANGELOGs excluded) for "import does not write" and "does not write it either" has one hit: a comment in the test file that quotes the retired clause. It also finds no other claim that the import or anything else fails to write `manager_id`; the only near-misses are two past-tense history notes ("had no product write surface") in `auth-route-ledger.ts` and `admin-set-user-manager.test.ts`, true of the column before the endpoint landed. With this card the enumeration covers `packages/lint/src`, `content/docs` and `skills/`.

## Verification

- Pin test, before the change: `Tests 47 passed (47)`; after: `Tests 47 passed (47)` (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-approval-approvers.test.ts`).
- Reverse verification, run from the committed fix: the source file restored to its parent version (working tree only), the same test: `Tests  2 failed | 45 passed (47)`, `expected 'sys_user.manager_id is not a profile …' to contain 'Set Manager'` and `... to contain '/api/v1/auth/admin/import-users'`. Direction: red, as expected. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- path`; the file's blob hash read `143561c356c5871ccbc2c42d082c1b854797171d` before and after, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- Whole package: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 135 passed (135)`, `Tests 6231 passed (6231)` (at b9731fc93c; the later commit changes one regex in the test file, re-run on its own: 47 passed).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit plus `check:test-typecheck`): OK. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run build`: success, `check-dts-emitted: 6/6`. In the built `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`: new clause 1, old clause 0, control string 1. `validateApprovalApprovers` called from the built `dist/index.cjs` on a manager-only flow returns one `info` finding whose hint carries the new text.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands from this diff at head d63e3f6ec1 (identical to the dispatch-time list); all 62 run on that head, every one exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`: `62 derived, 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Two ratchet gates (`check:type-check-debt`, `check:query-options-erasure`) hit this box's own 240 s runner cap under load 17 on the first pass and passed on re-run (`re-measured in 522.7s, 26 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number`; `ratchet holds`).
- Narrowed `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the two changed files: 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's. Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, line 328), so this diff cannot move the verdict of a file it did not touch.
- Control-character scan over the three files: none.

## Acceptance notes

- Not done: AGENTS.md section 10's "pull main and run the full suite once". `origin/main` moved to d8830c2805 during the run; its only difference from the base on `packages/lint` and `.changeset` is an unrelated changeset, so this branch was not merged forward. The merge queue validates the merged generation.
- Not run locally, CI's: the workspace type-check lanes, the sharded `Test Core`, `Build Core`, dogfood and temporal jobs, repo-wide `pnpm lint`.
- The `idp_provisioned` clause now says the import's column is refused too. That is the import's `applyUserManagerLink` delegation (covered by `admin-import-users-manager-pass.test.ts`, "directory-owned identity"), not a new claim about the endpoint.
- No `rule-explanations.ts`, `content/docs` or `skills/` edits.
